t: Polymer-modified, cementitious grout used for installation of stainless steel Helifix HeliBars into appropriate bed joints or cut slots in order to stabilise/reinstate the integrity of cracked masonry. Fully concealed and non-destructive, this is cost effective and more reliable than crack injection methods. With HeliBond grout, excellent bond strength is produced within the masonry, and the chance of the crack developing or new cracks appearing nearby is minimised. Storage life: 12 months.
